# EvaluLabs

> EvaluLabs (https://www.evalulabs.com) is an AI interview and candidate
> assessment platform. Candidates practise mock interviews against verified
> company and skill question banks. Hiring teams screen applicants with their
> own banks, invite links, rubric scores, and optional camera proctoring.

Not to be confused with Evalulab (evalulab.com), an unrelated clinical testing
company for cosmetics based in Montreal.

## Who it is for

- Candidates preparing for company or skill interviews.
- Hiring teams running structured first-round screening.
- Colleges sponsoring a plan for an email domain.

## Practice interviews

- Questions are contributed by verified sources: people who work at the company
  or interviewed there recently, confirmed via company email or offer letter.
  Nothing in the public bank is scraped or model-invented.
- The AI interviewer adopts each company's interviewing tone (formal, casual,
  or aggressive) when that tone is configured.
- Voice mode: answer out loud with real-time transcription.
- Coding and system-design questions open an in-session editor (JavaScript,
  TypeScript, Python, Java, C++, Go) or a written system-design workspace.
  Submissions and in-progress check-ins go to the AI interviewer. There is no
  hidden unit-test runner.
- Scoring uses an anchored 0-10 rubric across communication, technical depth,
  problem solving, and overall. Vague or blank answers score low by design.
  Paid plans also get topic-level insights.
- A progress view tracks scores across companies and roles.

## Enterprise hiring

- Upload a question bank (.csv, .xlsx, or .json). Interviews use that bank.
- Invite candidates with links. Review communication, technical depth, problem
  solving, and overall scores in the dashboard.
- Camera proctoring on enterprise invites: camera required; no-face and
  multiple-face checks; phone in frame; tab or window changes; paste detection
  and a devtools-dock heuristic logged as suspicious activity; short violation
  clips (about 15 seconds); a violation cap that can end the session; live
  camera viewing for the organization.
- Gaze-away and low-light checks are not active violation types.
- Pricing shown on the enterprise page: ₹199 per seat per month, or ₹19,999
  per month for unlimited seats (INR is the charged currency).

## Plans

- Free: a monthly allowance of AI mock interviews with scoring and feedback. No
  card required.
- Paid tiers: detailed insights, topic-level breakdowns, higher monthly limits.
- Top-up packs: extra interviews that roll over and do not reset on renewal.
- Institutional sponsorships: colleges and companies can grant a plan to
  everyone on their email domain, with a per-cycle interview limit they set.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.evalulabs.com/): what EvaluLabs is, and FAQ.
- [AI technical interviews](https://www.evalulabs.com/solutions/ai-technical-interviews): session loop for practice and screening.
- [AI coding interviews](https://www.evalulabs.com/solutions/ai-coding-interviews): editor, languages, and how grading works.
- [Interview proctoring](https://www.evalulabs.com/solutions/interview-proctoring): enterprise camera checks.
- [Companies](https://www.evalulabs.com/companies): company catalog for practice. The interactive picker requires an account; the page explains what is inside.
- [Skills](https://www.evalulabs.com/skills): skill catalog for practice. Same account requirement for the picker.
- [Pricing](https://www.evalulabs.com/pricing): candidate plan tiers, limits, and top-up packs.
- [About](https://www.evalulabs.com/about): question verification and how candidates are evaluated.
- [Enterprise](https://www.evalulabs.com/enterprise): hiring workspace, pricing, and FAQ.
- [Contact](https://www.evalulabs.com/contact): support and sponsorship enquiries.
